verdict.rationale: Brex claims AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payment, plus automated GL coding by entity. Its Payments API and MCP server, which can track bills, support routing and paying vendors. However, nothing in the evidence shows invoices being matched to purchase orders, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, documented detail on how invoice coding and approval routing work, independent or hands-on corroboration of AP automation.
